question: 4 条已结算预测（p=0.9/0.8/0.7/0.4，outcome=1/1/0/0）的 Brier 分数是多少？
verify:
from lifeplan.calibration import Prediction, compute_calibration
mk = lambda i, p, o: Prediction(i, 1, 'g', '事业深耕', '2026-01-31', p, 's', '2026-01-01', '2026-02-01', o)
preds = [mk(1, 0.9, 1), mk(2, 0.8, 1), mk(3, 0.7, 0), mk(4, 0.4, 0)]
rep = compute_calibration(preds)
result = round(rep.brier, 6)

question: tests/ 下 test_*.py 里用 ast 数出的 test_ 函数共多少个（与 README「190 项测试」对齐）？
verify:
import ast, pathlib, lifeplan
root = pathlib.Path(lifeplan.__file__).resolve().parent.parent
n = 0
for f in sorted((root / 'tests').glob('test_*.py')):
    tree = ast.parse(f.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    n += sum(1 for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name.startswith('test_'))
result = n
